commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Alejandro Rego (Ath Bilbao) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot on goal, but the ball curls just wide of the right post.
90+2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Oviedo.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
89' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle. Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) commits a foul after dangerous play.
87' Oviedo are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
85' Here's the change. Leander Dendoncker leaves the pitch and Kwasi Sibo (Real Oviedo) comes on as a substitute.
85' Here comes a substitution. Santiago Colombatto is given a rest as he is replaced by Alex Fores (Real Oviedo).
84' Ernesto Valverde decides to make a substitution. Gorka Guruzeta will be replaced by Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao).
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alex Berenguer leaves the pitch and Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao) comes on.
83' Oviedo exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.
81' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
78' The attendance for today's match is 47209.
77' 7:3 – the corner kicks stats.
75' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Aaron Escandell makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
74' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
72' That's the end of the game for Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta, who is replaced by Alejandro Rego (Ath Bilbao).
72' Ernesto Valverde prepares a substitution. Nico Williams is replaced by Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao).
72' The manager makes a subsitution with Pablo Agudin (Real Oviedo) coming on for Salomon Rondon.
72' Alberto Reina comes off the pitch to be replaced by Luka Ilic (Real Oviedo).
72' Rough tackle by Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
71' Oviedo are seeing far more of the ball now.
69' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 14:4.
67' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
65' Leander Dendoncker (Real Oviedo) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Cesar Soto Grado blows for a foul.
64' Selton Sanchez will be replaced by Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao).
63' Salomon Rondon (Real Oviedo) is furious with himself for wasting a glorious chance. He pounces on the rebound around the penalty spot and drags a shot well wide of the left post.

62' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Cesar Soto Grado with no other option than to blow for a foul.
59' The ratio of the ball possession is 49:51.
57' Aaron Escandell (Real Oviedo) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.

57' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Aaron Escandell pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
56' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) gathers a pass, skips past an opponent and lets fly from mid-range. His effort, however, is well wide of the right post.
55' The Oviedo players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
53' Oviedo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
53' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ilyas Chaira departs the field of play to be replaced by Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo).
51' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
49' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Ath Bilbao will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
48' The game is interrupted as Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) is flagged offside.
47' What was Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
46' Referee Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Oviedo comes to nothing.
45+3' Leander Dendoncker (Real Oviedo) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Unai Simon pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
45+3' Cesar Soto Grado interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao).

45+1' A short pass finds Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.
42' Looks like Aymeric Laporte (Ath Bilbao) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
40' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) is penalised for holding. Cesar Soto Grado signals a set piece.
39' The statistic for corner kicks – 6:1.
37' What a great touch by Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
35' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) meets a cross inside the box, but Unai Simon wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
33' Some great controlled play and passing from Oviedo. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
31' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Oviedo due to an offside in the build-up play.
30' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Oviedo players aren’t happy.
28' Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo) leaps high to plant a header low towards the middle of the goal. Unai Simon is unable to keep the ball out and the score is 1:1.
27' Total attempts – 6:1.

25' 1 - 0 Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Aaron Escandell is just a bystander as the ball flies off the bar into the back of the net. The score is 1:0.
24' Salomon Rondon (Real Oviedo) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.

22' Aymeric Laporte (Ath Bilbao) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post.
22' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
20' A quickly taken corner by Ath Bilbao.
18' Some neat passing and movement from Oviedo as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
16' 55:45 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
14' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
12' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) misses a rebound from close range. His effort floats narrowly over the crossbar!
12' The corner is swung in but Ath Bilbao can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
11' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Oviedo, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
10' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
9' Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
9' Ath Bilbao failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
8' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
6' One of the players from Oviedo times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
4' Some patient build-up play from Ath Bilbao as they look to unlock the defence.
2' Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
1' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Unai Simon intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Oviedo.
